verdict.rationale: Flagright's REST APIs let a developer retrieve users by a unique `userId`, including rule execution (decision) results. They also provide endpoints to get alerts by `alertId` and list cases with status filters, so stable-identifier retrieval exists across customers, alerts, cases and decisions. However, nothing documents a bulk export or reconciliation-oriented feed: data must be pulled resource by resource through the API. missing for 10: dedicated bulk/export capability, documented stable case and decision identifiers, pagination or incremental-sync guidance for reconciliation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export customer, alert, case and decision data with stable identifiers for reconciliation

citations.quote: Calling `GET /consumer/user/{userId}` will return the entire user payload and rule execution results for the user with the corresponding `userId`
